# envsync

> envsync provisions one machine from one JSON config. It checks each tool, installs missing tools, updates present tools, and reports an outcome for every tool.

envsync is a Node.js CLI. It accepts config sources from the current directory, a user config directory, a URL, or a GitHub repository. Commands can vary by selector, such as an OS, distro, package manager, or host.

## Documentation

- [Quick start](https://hades200082.github.io/env-sync/quick-start/): Create a config, add tools, and run envsync on a machine.
- [Configuration](https://hades200082.github.io/env-sync/configuration/): Learn the config fields, tool fields, and run order.
- [Commands](https://hades200082.github.io/env-sync/commands/): Learn command values, shells, platform maps, checks, environment refresh, and time limits.
- [Selectors](https://hades200082.github.io/env-sync/selectors/): Learn selector order, platform maps, platform filters, and host selectors.
- [Config sources](https://hades200082.github.io/env-sync/config-sources/): Learn lookup order and local, URL, and GitHub config sources.
- [Troubleshooting](https://hades200082.github.io/env-sync/troubleshooting/): Diagnose missing configs, unverified checks, unsupported commands, and failed commands.
- [Development](https://hades200082.github.io/env-sync/development/): Run tests and update the documentation site.

## Reference

- [JSON schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hades200082/env-sync/master/schema.json): Complete config validation schema.
- [Starter config](https://github.com/hades200082/env-sync/blob/master/examples/envsync.json): Example config for common tools.
- [Installer examples](https://github.com/hades200082/env-sync/blob/master/examples/installers.json): Common command forms and installer patterns.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/hades200082/env-sync): Source code, tests, issues, and release information.
